propositions: read-only derivations must compute agent-process metrics (attempts-per-ticket, first-pass-rate, rework-at-7/30-days, reopen-recovery, revert-linked-recovery) over the durable event store including retired events

metrics requiring per-event or multi-occurrence data (attempts, rework windows, reopen counts) must read raw event files using reused reducer helpers (event_sort_key, is_active_event, RETIRED_SUFFIX) rather than reinventing file handling
metrics requiring only terminal state (first_pass_rate via last_reopened_at absence, revert_recovery via reverts list) must read compiled state from reduce_ticket for simplicity

attempts_per_ticket must count distinct claim sessions via open→in_progress STATUS edges; first_pass_rate must measure fraction never reopened; rework_within_days(n) must find closed→open→closed within n days; reopen_recovery must count all closed→open edges; revert_recovery must filter reverts by target_event_type (STATUS/COMMITS only)
metrics returning None for empty ranges and 0 for measured-zero results must register with source=structural and confidence=high, and retired compaction events must be included in all counts
